pages.title: Color That Lasts
pages.text: Learn the distinct color workflow; fresh film and an album preserve your next journey.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Color developing uses Awkward, Thick and Mundane potions. Printing uses cyan, magenta and yellow dyes. High-sensitivity film trades extra brightness for noise.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Load black-and-white, color or a high-sensitivity film roll. Choose color capability and the high-sensitivity brightness/noise tradeoff.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Process the exposed color roll with Awkward, Thick and Mundane potions. Make developed color film; installed crafting recipe confirms these potion kinds.
